title: Annual Leave Policy
text: Brightwater Analytics gives every full-time employee 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays. Part-time employees receive leave pro rata based on contracted hours. Leave requests should be submitted in the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for absences longer than three days. Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the following year, but carried-over days must be used by March 31 or they are forfeited. Managers are asked to make sure their teams take at least two consecutive weeks off each year.

title: Remote Work Guidelines
text: Employees may work remotely for up to 3 days per week, subject to approval from their line manager. Remote work is arranged on a recurring weekly pattern so that teams can plan in-person collaboration days. All employees, wherever they are working, are expected to be available during core hours of 10:00 to 15:00 Dublin time. Outside core hours, people may arrange their schedule flexibly. Employees working remotely must use the company VPN and keep their laptop screen locked when unattended. Working from outside Ireland requires prior approval from HR.

title: Expense Claims
text: Business expenses must be submitted through the Ledgerly expense portal within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Claims submitted later than this require written approval from a director. Itemised receipts are required for any single expense over 25 euro. Approved claims are reimbursed in the next monthly payroll run. Alcohol, personal entertainment and traffic fines cannot be reimbursed. If you are unsure whether an expense is allowed, ask the finance team before spending the money rather than after.

title: Laptop and Equipment Policy
text: Engineers are issued a 14-inch laptop with 32 GB of memory, and all other staff receive a standard 13-inch model. Laptops are refreshed every 3 years, or sooner if a device fails and cannot be repaired. Employees may request one external monitor and a keyboard for home use. A lost or stolen laptop must be reported to the IT service desk within 24 hours so that the device can be remotely locked and wiped. Personal software may not be installed without IT approval.

title: Password and Authentication Policy
text: All company accounts must use passwords with a minimum length of 14 characters. Passphrases made of several unrelated words are encouraged because they are long and easy to remember. Passwords do not need to be rotated on a schedule, but must be changed immediately if there is any suspicion that they have been exposed. Multi-factor authentication through an authenticator app is mandatory for email, source control and the cloud console. SMS codes are not accepted as a second factor. Sharing passwords, even with colleagues, is prohibited.

title: Parental Leave
text: Brightwater Analytics offers 26 weeks of parental leave at full salary to primary caregivers, including adoptive parents. Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks at full salary, which can be taken in up to three blocks within the first year. Employees become eligible after completing their probation period. Employees returning from primary caregiver leave may work a phased return at 80 percent of their usual hours on full pay for the first four weeks. Requests should be discussed with HR at least eight weeks before the planned start date.

title: Learning and Development Budget
text: Each employee has a learning budget of 1,500 euro per year to spend on courses, certifications, books and conference tickets. The budget resets every January and unused amounts do not carry over. Requests must be submitted through the learning request form at least 10 working days before the purchase. Travel costs for attending conferences are covered separately under the travel policy. Employees who attend a conference are encouraged to share what they learned in a short internal talk within a month of returning.

title: On-Call Rotation
text: Engineering teams that own production services run a weekly on-call rotation. Each rotation starts on Monday at 09:00 and ends the following Monday at 09:00, with a handover meeting at the change of shift. Engineers on call receive an allowance of 300 euro per week, plus time off in lieu for any incident that requires work between midnight and 06:00. Nobody should be on call for more than one week in any four-week period. Pages must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.

title: Brightwater Pulse: Dashboard FAQ
text: Brightwater Pulse is our analytics product for operations teams. Pulse dashboards refresh automatically every 15 minutes, and users can trigger a manual refresh at any time. On the Standard plan, historical data is retained for 13 months, while Enterprise customers can configure retention of up to seven years. Dashboards can be shared with colleagues inside the same workspace or exported as PDF reports. Each workspace can hold an unlimited number of dashboards, although very large dashboards may load more slowly.

title: Brightwater Pulse: Pricing
text: The Pulse Standard plan costs 49 euro per user per month and includes all core dashboards, alerting and integrations. The Enterprise plan is priced individually and adds single sign-on, extended data retention and a dedicated customer success manager. Customers who choose annual billing receive a 15 percent discount compared with monthly billing. A free 14-day trial of the Standard plan is available with no payment details required. Non-profit organisations can apply for a reduced rate through the sales team.

title: Customer Support Service Levels
text: Brightwater classifies support tickets by priority. For Enterprise customers, Priority 1 incidents, meaning a full outage of Pulse, receive a first response within 1 hour, 24 hours a day, seven days a week. For Standard customers, Priority 1 incidents receive a first response within 4 business hours. Priority 2 issues receive a response within one business day on both plans. Business hours are 08:00 to 18:00 Dublin time, Monday to Friday. Customers can track the status of every ticket in the support portal.

title: Pulse API Rate Limits
text: The Pulse public API allows up to 600 requests per minute per API key. When this limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP status 429 together with a Retry-After header indicating how many seconds to wait. Clients should implement exponential backoff rather than retrying immediately. Bulk data access should use the export endpoints instead of paging through the query API. Enterprise customers can request a higher limit through their customer success manager, subject to a review of their expected traffic.

title: Data Export
text: Pulse supports exporting data in CSV and Parquet formats. A single export can contain a maximum of 2 million rows; larger datasets should be split by date range. Exports are generated in the background and a download link is emailed when the file is ready. Download links expire after seven days. Scheduled exports can be configured to run daily or weekly and deliver files directly to a customer's own cloud storage bucket. Exports respect the same permissions as dashboards, so users only export data they can already see.

title: Dublin Office Information
text: The Brightwater Dublin office occupies the fourth floor of the building. The building opens at 07:00 and closes at 21:00 on weekdays, and is closed at weekends unless access has been arranged in advance with facilities. Employees collect their access badge from reception on their first day. Visitors must sign in at the reception kiosk and be accompanied by their host at all times. Bicycle parking and showers are available in the basement. Meeting rooms can be booked through the calendar system.

title: Security Incident Reporting
text: Any suspected security incident, such as a phishing email that was clicked, a lost device containing company data, or unexpected access to a system, must be reported in the sec-incidents channel within 1 hour of discovery. Do not try to investigate or fix the problem yourself before reporting it. The security team will acknowledge the report and coordinate next steps. Reporting a mistake quickly is always treated as the right thing to do, and nobody is disciplined for honestly reporting an incident.

title: Business Travel Policy
text: Flights shorter than 6 hours must be booked in economy class. For flights longer than 6 hours, business class may be booked with prior approval from a director. Hotels within the European Union are capped at 180 euro per night, while hotels in London, New York and San Francisco are capped at 260 euro per night. All travel should be booked through the company travel platform so that the company knows where employees are in an emergency. Daily meal allowances are paid according to the national rates.

title: Performance Reviews
text: Brightwater runs performance reviews twice a year, in May and November. Before each review, employees complete a written self-assessment, which is due two weeks before the review meeting. Managers also gather feedback from up to four peers chosen together with the employee. Reviews focus on impact, collaboration and growth rather than ratings alone. Salary changes are discussed only in the November cycle. Employees who disagree with their review outcome can request a follow-up conversation with their manager's manager.

title: Onboarding New Employees
text: Every new hire is paired with an onboarding buddy for their first 60 days. The buddy is a colleague from a different team who helps the new hire find their way around and answers informal questions. Laptops and equipment are shipped to remote new hires 5 working days before their start date. During the first week, new hires attend sessions on company history, security and the Pulse product. A check-in with HR takes place at the end of the first month to gather feedback on the onboarding experience.

title: Sick Leave
text: Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year at full salary. Employees should notify their manager as early as possible on any day they are unable to work. A medical certificate is required for absences of more than 3 consecutive days. Sick leave can also be used to care for a dependent family member who is ill. Long-term illness is handled case by case with HR, and the company provides an employee assistance programme that offers confidential support.

title: Code Review Standards
text: Every change to a production service requires at least two approvals from engineers on the owning team. Pull requests should be kept small: any pull request above 400 lines of changed code should normally be split into smaller pieces that can be reviewed independently. Reviewers aim to give a first response within one working day. Automated tests and linting must pass before a change can be merged. Authors should describe what the change does, why it is needed and how it was tested.

title: Deployment Freeze
text: There is a company-wide production deployment freeze from 20 December to 3 January each year, when many people are on holiday and support coverage is reduced. During the freeze, only emergency fixes for customer-impacting incidents may be deployed, and each one requires approval from the VP of Engineering. Teams are encouraged to finish risky migrations well before the freeze begins. Feature flags may still be toggled during the freeze if the change has been tested in staging.

title: Pulse Integrations
text: Pulse includes built-in connectors for Slack, Jira and Salesforce, which can be enabled by a workspace administrator. Alerts can be posted to Slack channels, and Jira tickets can be created automatically when a metric crosses a threshold. For other tools, Pulse supports outgoing webhooks with a maximum payload size of 256 KB. Webhook deliveries are retried up to five times with increasing delays if the receiving server does not respond. Integration activity is recorded in the workspace audit log.

title: Data Residency and Backups
text: Data for customers located in the European Union is stored exclusively in our Frankfurt cloud region. Customers elsewhere can choose between the Frankfurt and Virginia regions when creating a workspace. Encrypted backups are taken every 6 hours and retained for 35 days. Backups are stored in a separate region from the primary data. The disaster recovery plan is tested twice a year. Customers can request a copy of their data, or its deletion, by contacting support.

title: Refund Policy
text: Customers on an annual Pulse plan can request a full refund within 30 days of their first purchase if they are not satisfied. After this period, cancellations of annual plans receive a prorated refund for the remaining full months. Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time and remain active until the end of the current billing period, but are not refunded. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within ten business days of approval.

title: Bike to Work Scheme
text: Brightwater participates in a bike to work scheme that allows employees to buy a bicycle and safety equipment up to a value of 1,250 euro, or 1,500 euro for an electric bicycle. The cost is repaid through salary deductions over 12 months, before tax. Employees can use the scheme once every four years. To apply, choose a bicycle from a participating shop and submit the quote through the HR portal.

title: Pension Plan
text: The company matches employee pension contributions up to 6 percent of base salary. For example, if an employee contributes 5 percent, the company also contributes 5 percent. Company contributions vest immediately, so they belong to the employee from the first day. Employees can change their contribution rate once per quarter through the pension provider's website. Free sessions with an independent financial adviser are offered twice a year.

title: Wellness Allowance
text: Every employee can claim a wellness allowance of 400 euro per year. The allowance can be spent on gym memberships, fitness classes, sports equipment or mindfulness apps. Claims are submitted through the expense portal with a receipt. The allowance resets every January and cannot be carried over. In addition, the Dublin office hosts a free yoga class every Wednesday at lunchtime.

title: Spark Days Hackathon
text: Twice a year, Brightwater runs Spark Days, a two-day internal hackathon where employees can work on any idea they like, alone or in teams. Projects are presented to the whole company at the end of the second day. The winning team chooses a charity to receive a donation of 2,000 euro from the company. Several features of the Pulse product, including scheduled exports, started as Spark Days projects.

title: Pulse Alerts
text: Pulse alerts notify users when a metric crosses a threshold or changes unusually. On the Standard plan, each workspace can have up to 50 alert rules. Enterprise workspaces have no limit on alert rules. Alerts can be delivered by email, Slack or the Pulse mobile app, and SMS alerts are available only on the Enterprise plan. Each alert rule can have a quiet period to avoid repeated notifications for the same problem.

title: Company History
text: Brightwater Analytics was founded in 2017 in Galway by two former data engineers who wanted to make operational data easier to understand. The company launched its first version of Pulse in 2019. Today Brightwater employs around 240 people across offices in Dublin, Galway and Lisbon, and serves customers in more than 20 countries. The company's values are clarity, ownership and care.
